repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

Seat routes on PR #36884 · 2026-11-24T08:23Z

**Option A, accepted on 2026-11-24T07:01Z** in the card thread, written here as the record (L2 7126056204, E2). Retiring 「界面」 removed the only door that customizes a read-only base's view, dashboard, report or page into its pair (ADR-0146). That door now lives in All metadata: those four types join `AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES`, so on a read-only base they open the bundle item editor with Customize, the type's designer, the override chip and Restore. The `studio-customize-journey` e2e and the checklist item move to the new path; they are not retired. Not taken: B (reversing #35974, out of scope) and C (accepting the capability loss).

**E1, the HotCRM walk line** ("change a menu, a list view, a dashboard and a record-page grouping, all in the app, no Studio needed"): accepted with a stated limit. On an installed (read-only) package, the in-app View settings of a shipped list view offers only "Save as my view", which is personal. A shared change to that shipped view is made on its All-metadata page. This limit predates the PR (#35974), and the PR neither adds nor removes it. The card thread's live walk on HotCRM records each of the four writes on the PR. The maintainer brief states the limit plainly.
